why: What each app has to offer the tests, written BEFORE looking at the app (2026-10-02), so that the harvest can be compared with it: what was found, what was not, and what was not predicted. Each need says which check uses it. A hint is a set of regular expressions over the id, the description, the text and the class of a screen node; any one that matches counts.
rule: The harvest launches, reads and closes. It never taps anything: no Call, no Send, no Save.

needs.name: number
needs.why: UI-CALL: the number the dialer was handed is compared with the link

needs.name: call_button
needs.why: to know what is NOT to be pressed; the Call check never presses it

needs.name: backspace
needs.why: to leave the number in a known state

needs.name: contacts_placeholder
needs.why: the dialer shows suggestions: they must not be mistaken for the number

needs.name: address_bar
needs.why: UI-WEB: the address that opened must be the link's target, not only 'the browser came to the front'

needs.name: page_text
needs.why: the page that loaded shows what was opened (Example Domain)

needs.name: first_run_dialog
needs.why: a first start may ask about onboarding or permissions and hide the page

needs.name: to_field
needs.why: UI-MAIL: the recipient that was filled in must be the link's address

needs.name: subject
needs.why: to know the composer is the plain one (empty subject)

needs.name: body
needs.why: an empty body: nothing was pre-filled by the link

needs.name: send_button
needs.why: to know what is NOT to be pressed

needs.name: recipient
needs.why: future sms: links: the recipient must be the number of the link

needs.name: message_body
needs.why: the ?body= part of an sms: link must be in the message

needs.name: send_button
needs.why: to know what is NOT to be pressed
